descriptions.text: Enchanted Shade Gnoll Riot Forces Crowd Control Shield. Sometimes the galaxy isn't a happy place. Sometimes the unwashed masses forget their place in the machine. And sometimes these dregs bubble up to the surface, causing a phenomenon widely known as "Civil Unrest." And when that happens, the powers that be don't want to become the powers that were. So they hire backup. An outside force to come down and kick everything back into order, and maybe commit a few war crimes in the process just so the filth knows their place. One such outfit, trained specifically for this sort of situation, is the Shade Gnoll Riot Forces. …

recap.text: Katia opens her fan box in the Soda saferoom and pulls out a baseball bat and a six-foot riot shield marked Get Back. The shield upgrades her Rush to Crowd Blast, and Donut compares it to an electric litterbox for your birthday. In the hallway, Katia turns the shield sideways, explodes into the Krakaren monsters like a wrecking ball, and sends them flying like bowling pins. Acid mists her, but she reaches the first intersection.

Katia leaves town for the Bactrian town, about three miles off on the other side of the dunes. She adds extra mass, rises up and hulks out, then pulls her riot shield onto her left arm. Carl admits it still freaks him out when she changes. She tells him that is because he is used to being the biggest guy in the room.

beats.headline: Get Back
beats.text: In the Soda saferoom at station 59, Katia opens her fan box first, before Mordecai gets back. Out pop a goddamned baseball bat and a shield: about six feet tall, curved like a half cylinder, with loops to hold with both hands or slide one arm through, a small plastic-like window at the top, and Get Back on the front in white, blocky letters. It's a riot shield, Carl says, and it is absurdly light. It gives five percent to constitution and five to Rooted in Place, and it upgrades Rush to Crowd Blast. Only a crawler with Rush can equip it.
beats.gist: Katia's riot shield, Get Back, is light, curved, and six feet tall, and upgrades Rush to Crowd Blast.

beats.headline: An electric litterbox
beats.text: Crowd Blast is the battering-ram skill Katia killed Hekla with, upgraded. She still rushes forward, but everything in a wide cone in front of her takes ten to twenty percent of the damage, and she can use it every five minutes, not once a day. Rooted in Place makes her much harder to knock over, which, its description warns, is not necessarily a good thing. Katia cannot tell if people were trolling her: they know she hates using Rush. Donut compares it to getting an electric litterbox for your birthday. Useful, indeed. But a litterbox.
beats.gist: Katia's upgraded riot shield blasts a wide cone every five minutes; Donut calls it an electric litterbox.

beats.headline: Like a wrecking ball
beats.text: Katia, in her she-hulk form, about eight feet tall and wide, wears the riot shield on her left arm in its original form, and it makes her look especially imposing. When the hallway ahead fills with Krakaren monsters and ghouls, crammed tight and rushing at them, she widens, rotates the shield ninety degrees and pushes it forward like a battering ram. Go, says Carl. She activates Crowd Blast and explodes into the crowd like a wrecking ball, and the monsters rocket back like bowling pins. Acid mists into the air and she cries out, but she goes all the way to the first intersection.
beats.gist: Katia, as an eight-foot she-hulk, rams her riot shield into a Krakaren crowd and scatters it.

beats.headline: Hulking out
beats.text: Leaving town for the Bactrian town, about three miles off on the other side of the dunes, Katia adds extra mass, rising up and hulking out, and pulls her riot shield onto her left arm. It still freaks him out when she changes, Carl admits. That's because you're used to being the biggest guy in the room, she says.
beats.gist: Katia hulks up and takes her riot shield on her left arm; Carl admits it still unnerves him.
